Icons not updating after a pack update?

Launchers cache rendered cards in memory and on disk, so a fresh pack can sit behind yesterday\'s bitmaps. Settings → Refresh launcher icons re-sends the apply contract; if that is not enough, Settings → Launcher app info opens the system page where Force Stop clears the cache without rebooting the TV.
Manual icon overrides win over the pack

Projectivy keeps an icon you picked by hand until you pick again, so a per-app override survives every pack update. Re-assign the tile from the launcher\'s icon picker, or choose the pack default there, to hand the tile back to Core Builds.
Send to Monet: what it can and cannot take

Wallpapers go to Monet straight from Preview or Export (Send to Monet, Monet 1.0.72 or newer, Premium). The icon pack does not: Monet has no apply intent. It discovers packs through the standard discovery actions, and you choose Core Builds under Monet Settings → Apps → Icon pack.
An installed app has no icon

Auto-assign needs the exact activity your box launches, and some apps ship different mobile and Leanback activities. Read the component off the device with the ADB scanning guide in the repo docs and send a mapping request; the next tranche picks it up.
